title: The influence of Standard German on the vowels and diphthongs of West Central Bavarian
why_promising: Primary production study with vowel boundaries and formant errors explicitly manually corrected. F1/F2 trajectories were time-normalized from acoustic onset to offset to eleven points, making it a potentially high-value trajectory source for the master database.
open_question: Need to locate and verify a publicly accessible source deposit/supplement containing token-level production observations or annotation files, establish redistribution terms, and identify whether raw trajectories/landmarks are deposited rather than only article-level summaries.
